# Ferretería Arocena

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Hardware and paint store in Montevideo with an online store on the Fenicio platform. Sells paints, tools, electrical and plumbing supplies, construction materials, heating and air conditioning, and garden and pool products. States nationwide delivery via La Nave in 24 to 72 business hours and same-day delivery in Montevideo.
